name: Manuel Urteaga
office: Rio Hondo Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Manuel Urteaga is a chiropractor and educator. He is a small business owner and former Rio Hondo College student running for the Rio Hondo Community College District board. He serves on the Rio Hondo Foundation board and as president of the Whittier Community Foundation. His campaign says he supports expanding access, increasing enrollment, strengthening academic programs and career and technical education, and building partnerships with local businesses.
